SELECT ar.*,
       -- Interruptor general (script 133): sin él en 'true' no sale ningún email
       -- automático aunque la regla tenga auto_send_email.
       COALESCE((SELECT LOWER(sc.value) FROM public.system_configurations sc
                 WHERE sc.key = 'alert_email_auto_send_enabled' LIMIT 1), 'false') = 'true'
         AS email_auto_send_globally_enabled
FROM public.alert_rules ar
WHERE ar.is_active = true
  AND (
    (
      ar.next_execution_at IS NULL
      OR CAST(ar.next_execution_at AS DATE) <= CAST($1 AS DATE)
    )
    OR (
      $2 ILIKE 'MANUAL'
    )
  );

parameters.query:
WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO public.alert_instances (
    rule_id,
    reference_table,
    reference_id,
    patient_id,
    alert_date,
    event_date,
    title,
    priority,
    details_json,
    status,
    summary,
    occurrence_key
  )
  VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3, $4, $5,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($10::text, '')::timestamp, '{{ $now }}'::timestamp),
    $6, $7, $8,
    'PENDING', $9, $11
  )
  ON CONFLICT (rule_id, reference_table, reference_id, occurrence_key)
  DO NOTHING
  RETURNING *
),
-- Ocurrencia nueva del mismo registro (cambio la fecha del evento): las
-- alertas anteriores que nadie atendio quedan reemplazadas por esta.
superseded AS (
  UPDATE public.alert_instances o
  SET status = 'SUPPRESSED',
      notes = concat_ws(E'\n', NULLIF(o.notes, ''),
                        'Reemplazada por la alerta #' || ins.id || ': cambió la fecha del evento.'),
      updated_at = now()
  FROM ins
  WHERE $12::text <> 'state'
    AND o.rule_id = ins.rule_id
    AND o.reference_table = ins.reference_table
    AND o.reference_id = ins.reference_id
    AND o.id <> ins.id
    AND o.status = 'PENDING'
  RETURNING o.id
)
SELECT * FROM ins;

UPDATE public.alert_rules
SET 
    next_execution_at = CASE 
        WHEN recurrence_type = 'DAILY'   THEN (CAST($1 AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 day')
        WHEN recurrence_type = 'WEEKLY'  THEN (CAST($1 AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 week')
        WHEN recurrence_type = 'MONTHLY' THEN (CAST($1 AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '1 month')
        WHEN recurrence_type = 'ONCE'    THEN NULL
        ELSE next_execution_at 
    END,
    is_active = CASE 
        WHEN recurrence_type = 'ONCE' THEN false
        ELSE is_active 
    END,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = $2;
